Standard IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 21):2024: Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters - Specification.

Applicable Products: electric water heater, storage geyser, water geyser, domestic electric geyser, stationary water heater, pressurized storage geyser, hot water storage tank.

Sector: Food, Beverages & Public Health | Year: 2012 | Status: Current / Mandatory Public Health Standard | Effective: 2012-06-01.
Applicable Products: drinking water, potable water, piped water, tap water, community drinking water, treated water supply, well water.
Product Characteristics: Clear, colourless, odourless, palatable water free from pathogenic bacteria and viruses; Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) acceptable limit 500 mg/L (permissible up to 2000 mg/L in absence of alternate source); Strict zero-tolerance for heavy metals (Arsenic, Lead, Mercury, Chromium).
Intended Use: Human consumption, cooking, food preparation, and municipal public drinking water systems.
